rules.description: Checks that all percentage StatVars do not exceed 100%.
Checks that all percentage StatVars are not below 0%.
Checks observations cover 50 US states plus DC (50-52 entities).
Verifies that MaxDate meets expected vintage per StatVar cohort.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(MaxDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS max_year, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs, CASE WHEN StatVar = 'Percent_Person_WithAllTeethLoss' THEN 2016 WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, 'CorePreventiveServices') THEN 2020 WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, 'HighBloodPressure|Cholesterol|ChronicKidneyDisease') THEN 2021 ELSE 2022 END AS expected_year FROM stats
params.condition: max_year IS NOT NULL AND max_year >= expected_year AND total_svs > 0
